posts.title: Ruby 4.0 upgrade: faster, but more memory growth
posts.description: Upgrading to Ruby 4.0 (from 3.3) made the updown.io Sidekiq workers 15% faster in my benchmark (yay 🎉) but one day after deploying it, my servers started running low on memory. Here's how I tracked it down to a change in the Ruby 4.0 garbage collector, and the "fix".
